# Results summary (auto-generated by `python -m blend.analyze`)

Gap = English accuracy - local-language accuracy (pp); negative = local language better.

**`official`** (BLEnD soft exact match) is the PRIMARY analysis. **`strict`** (first answer only)
is a SENSITIVITY analysis: it asks whether a result depends on crediting list answers.

## Response counts

| Setting | Stored responses | Evaluable (valid questions x model x language) |
|---|---|---|
| Azerbaijan | 2,000 | 1,876 |
| Iran | 1,824 | 1,824 |
| **Total** | **3,824** | **3,700** |

Azerbaijan was queried for all 500 questions (31 are excluded by BLEnD's validity rule afterwards); Iran only for its 456 valid questions. Use these numbers rather than '4,000 responses'.

## Sensitivity summary

| Setting | Test | Official (primary) | Strict (sensitivity) | Robust? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Azerbaijan · GPT-4.1 | language gap (McNemar) | +0.9 pp, p = .781 (n.s.) | -6.2 pp, p = .014 (local better) | **no** |
| Azerbaijan · Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite | language gap (McNemar) | -9.6 pp, p < .001 (local better) | -9.8 pp, p < .001 (local better) | yes |
| Iran · GPT-4.1 | language gap (McNemar) | -3.9 pp, p = .127 (n.s.) | -7.7 pp, p = .005 (local better) | **no** |
| Iran · Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite | language gap (McNemar) | -7.5 pp, p = .015 (local better) | -2.0 pp, p = .550 (n.s.) | **no** |
| Azerbaijan · GPT-4.1 | language × domain (GEE) | p = .039 (sig.) | p = .264 (n.s.) | **no** |
| Azerbaijan · Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite | language × domain (GEE) | p = .014 (sig.) | p = .015 (sig.) | yes |
| Iran · GPT-4.1 | language × domain (GEE) | p = .224 (n.s.) | p = .283 (n.s.) | yes |
| Iran · Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite | language × domain (GEE) | p < .001 (sig.) | p = .001 (sig.) | yes |

3 of 4 language effects depend on whether list answers are credited.

## RQ1 overall - official scoring

- Azerbaijan / GPT-4.1 (n=469): English 70.6% vs local 69.7%, gap +0.9 pp [-3.6, +5.3], McNemar p = .781 (EN-only 60, local-only 56)
- Azerbaijan / Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite (n=469): English 56.1% vs local 65.7%, gap -9.6 pp [-14.1, -5.1], McNemar p < .001 (EN-only 37, local-only 82)
- Iran / GPT-4.1 (n=456): English 69.7% vs local 73.7%, gap -3.9 pp [-8.8, +0.9], McNemar p = .127 (EN-only 53, local-only 71)
- Iran / Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite (n=456): English 57.7% vs local 65.1%, gap -7.5 pp [-13.2, -1.8], McNemar p = .015 (EN-only 75, local-only 109)

## RQ2 language x domain - official scoring

- Azerbaijan / GPT-4.1: GEE chi2(5) = 11.69, p = .039; discordant-pair permutation p = .035
- Azerbaijan / Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite: GEE chi2(5) = 14.29, p = .014; discordant-pair permutation p = .034
- Iran / GPT-4.1: GEE chi2(5) = 6.95, p = .224; discordant-pair permutation p = .274
- Iran / Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite: GEE chi2(5) = 25.33, p < .001; discordant-pair permutation p < .001
- largest domain gaps: Iran/Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite Food -28.1 pp (Holm p < .001); Azerbaijan/Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite Food -19.4 pp (Holm p = .005); Azerbaijan/Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite Holidays/Celebration/Leisure -18.7 pp (Holm p = .013); Iran/Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite Work life +17.2 pp (Holm p = .133)

## RQ1 overall - strict scoring

- Azerbaijan / GPT-4.1 (n=469): English 61.6% vs local 67.8%, gap -6.2 pp [-10.9, -1.5], McNemar p = .014 (EN-only 51, local-only 80)
- Azerbaijan / Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite (n=469): English 54.6% vs local 64.4%, gap -9.8 pp [-14.5, -5.3], McNemar p < .001 (EN-only 40, local-only 86)
- Iran / GPT-4.1 (n=456): English 57.9% vs local 65.6%, gap -7.7 pp [-12.9, -2.6], McNemar p = .005 (EN-only 57, local-only 92)
- Iran / Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite (n=456): English 55.9% vs local 57.9%, gap -2.0 pp [-7.7, +3.7], McNemar p = .550 (EN-only 85, local-only 94)

## RQ2 language x domain - strict scoring

- Azerbaijan / GPT-4.1: GEE chi2(5) = 6.46, p = .264; discordant-pair permutation p = .352
- Azerbaijan / Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite: GEE chi2(5) = 14.04, p = .015; discordant-pair permutation p = .036
- Iran / GPT-4.1: GEE chi2(5) = 6.25, p = .283; discordant-pair permutation p = .277
- Iran / Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite: GEE chi2(5) = 20.12, p = .001; discordant-pair permutation p = .002
- largest domain gaps: Iran/Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite Food -21.9 pp (Holm p = .015); Azerbaijan/Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite Food -20.4 pp (Holm p = .002); Azerbaijan/Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite Holidays/Celebration/Leisure -17.3 pp (Holm p = .053); Iran/Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite Work life +15.6 pp (Holm p = .262)

## RQ3 between-setting comparison of the gap (Azerbaijan - Iran)

The two BLEnD settings differ in language, culture AND question set, so this is a descriptive between-setting comparison, not a causal country/culture effect.

- GPT-4.1, official: +4.8 pp [-1.8, +11.3], permutation p = .156
- GPT-4.1, strict: +1.5 pp [-5.6, +8.6], permutation p = .712
- Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, official: -2.1 pp [-9.6, +5.0], permutation p = .606
- Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, strict: -7.8 pp [-15.3, -0.7], permutation p = .038

Interpretation (official = primary): the observed language gaps differed numerically between the two settings, but the between-setting difference was not significant for either model.
Under strict scoring (sensitivity only) the difference for Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite reaches p = .038; report it separately as a robustness result, not as the main finding.
